data: Is the 'edge_factored' predictor generally worse than the 'action_state' predictor in terms of True Positive Rate?

The 'edge_factored' predictor is generally below the 'action_state' predictor in terms of True Positive Rate. This can be observed from the position of the yellow line (representing 'edge_factored') relative to the blue line (representing 'action_state'). The yellow line consistently lies below the blue line across most of the range of False Positive Rates, indicating a lower True Positive Rate for 'edge_factored'.
